==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. 

This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (My team includes Leon, Johnson, Second Brain, and I.) (My Ghostly UFO, named Leon, resembles a ghostly flying saucer with an ethereal green glow.) (Johnson resembles an orange, humanoid goldfish. He wears a blue astronaut suit but his suit doesn't have a helmet.) (Second Brain is a floating brain made of Lucid Light.) (Lucid Light is a reality warping energy wielded by Lucid Lords. It resembles sparkling purple energy that shines like a night sky full of stars.) (The Storyverse is a multiverse where all possible story ideas exist as cosmic bubble universes that float together in a cosmic void.)

We traveled to a tunnel world of thought reactive slime that becomes anything you want.

Our fun with the slime is stopped by a trio of slime women. (Three beautiful women made of green glowing slime wearing shiny white pop idol outfits.)

The slime is made of toxic waste that the women feed on, and our over use was weakening the women.
